projects.name: Gen Alpha Intelligence Lab
projects.blurb: A living research lab on the forces shaping Gen Alpha culture: insights, findings, creators, and the spaces they actually occupy, with an ingest pipeline for reports, interviews, and field notes.

projects.name: Kindling
projects.blurb: A card game for people who want more of each other: 334 cards across four decks, heat 1 to 5, with consent built into every rule. Play it free online or pre-order the box.

projects.name: Life Gamified
projects.blurb: A fantasy RPG quest journal for real life. Tasks become quests, you earn XP, level up your character, unlock achievements, and grow a talent tree, with an AI scribe that keeps pace with your days.

projects.name: Grandmaster
projects.blurb: A live, shared chess tournament hub for your friend group: round-robin, Swiss, and elimination brackets everyone can watch, with Chess.com integration and seeding by rating.

projects.name: The Man and the Machine
projects.blurb: Play bass or connect MIDI and the AI plays back. A real-time jam session with 10 AI musician personalities, from Supportive to Adversary.
projects.built: React + Web Audio API · Claude Code

projects.name: Jukeboxd
projects.blurb: Track, rate, and review albums. Share your musical journey and discover new sounds.

projects.name: Ætheria
projects.blurb: AI-generated binaural beats for focus, relaxation, and meditation: custom soundscapes tuned to your state of mind.

projects.name: Meme Library
projects.blurb: Describe the meme you half remember and it finds it. Natural-language recall across 1,000+ source-linked clips, reactions, and GIFs, each with provenance and a timeline of how it spread.

projects.name: Dreamcatcher
projects.blurb: Speak your dream the second you wake up. An adaptive AI interview deepens the recall, then reads it back through four lenses and correlates it with your sleep.

projects.name: Veritas
projects.blurb: AI-powered bias detection for news and media. Analyze perspective, compare sources, and see the full picture.
projects.built: Google AI Studio · built on Approachable AI

projects.name: Creator Search
projects.blurb: Find the right creators for a brand by audience, style, and engagement.

projects.name: Digital Closet Archive
projects.blurb: Catalog, style, and manage your closet with outfit recommendations.

projects.name: Momentum
projects.blurb: Goal tracking with smart task management and progress insights.

projects.name: Perfect Day Crafter
projects.blurb: Design your ideal day: routines, schedules, and habits that line up with your goals.
